text.p: Former Roma and Italy midfielder Giuseppe Giannini, who joined Austria's Sturm Graz over the summer declaring he would not play in Italy again, said on Wednesday he had changed his mind.

Giannini, who spent 15 years at Roma, left saying he could never imagine having to play against his beloved club. But on Wednesday, mobbed by fans at a Rome book signing, the 32-year-old known as "The Prince" by adoring supporters said that "certain comments by the club" had wounded him after he left for Austria.

"It was a lack of respect towards me. For that reason I would like to show I can still play in Italy. It's not true that I am homesick. But the challenges of the Italian championship are tempting," he said.
The Italian media has linked the player with Cagliari, but Giannini said the reports were "rumours, for now".
